# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## Surface per-task trial rewards and a noise floor to the optimizer (cand_0003)
- The gate rejects on a significance bar (2·SE), but the optimizer only sees a scalar mean val and the
  LEDGER's broke/fixed/unresolved buckets AFTER the fact. With 3 trials × 10 tasks, a genuinely-correct
  fix that converts one ALWAYS-0 task to passing is only ~+0.1 val — easily inside the noise floor, so a
  real fix and a no-op are indistinguishable to the optimizer at propose time. Two concrete asks:
  (1) expose each task's per-trial reward vector + its SE in the working dir (e.g. `score.trial_rewards`
  was present in the trajectory JSON but empty) so the optimizer can see which tasks are high-variance;
  (2) let a candidate REQUEST more trials for specific tasks (or raise N globally) when its edits are
  proven-safe pure code — re-measuring is the framework's own advised lever for a net-zero, but there is
  no mechanism for the optimizer to invoke it.

## "EMPTY SEED — create from scratch" boilerplate fired on a non-empty capability (cand_0003)
- The INSTRUCTIONS contained an "EMPTY SEED … the capability directory is EMPTY (no pre-existing content)"
  block, but policy/policy.md and tools/tools.py were both present (the seed). The contradictory guidance
  cost time to reconcile. Gate the empty-seed section on `is_empty(dir)` so it only appears when true.
